The vendor directly providing the **Jobber** software product at **getjobber.com** is **Octopusapp Inc.** (doing business as **Jobber**).

### Supporting Evidence
According to the Jobber Privacy Policy hosted on the domain:
> *"Octopusapp Inc. d/b/a Jobber (“Jobber”/“we”/“us”/“our”) provides services that allow business customers to run a home service business by providing customer relationship management, scheduling, billing, invoicing, payment integration function, and payment processing services, collectively (the “Service”). Jobber owns and operates the website located at https://getjobber.com/..."*
